title: Few influential coordinates
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function and let $\tau > 0$. The number of $\tau$-influential coordinates of $f$ — those $i \in [n]$ with $\mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \ge \tau$ — is bounded by
\[
  \abs{J_\tau(f)} \;\le\; \frac{I[f]}{\tau},
\]
where $I[f] = \sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$ is the total influence.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $\tau > 0$ the number of $\tau$-influential coordinates satisfies
$\abs{J_\tau(f)} \le I[f]/\tau$.
